summary.text: Deqa Dhalac, a Democrat, represents House District 120 (South Portland) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in South Portland. The House profile lists membership on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives social worker as the occupation and lists UNH and UNE, with master's degrees in Development Policy and Practice and in Social Work.
